title: “You left Paris for this?” On coming home
excerpt: I worked as an architect in Paris until 2023, then came home to Tunisia. For a lot of people, that only makes sense as a failure. I see it differently.

title: Eating Grapes While Lying Down: Imperial Myth or Modern Fantasy?
excerpt: Is it a cliché or real ?

title: حول قصة أكل عنزة لورقة من القرآن، للتشكيك فيه
excerpt: قصة أكل عنزة لورقة تتعلق بآيات منسوخة؛ والقرآن محفوظ في صدور الصحابة ووعد الله بحفظه، لذا فالسخرية منها تدل على جهل بعلوم القرآن وتاريخه.

title: When clicking was an act of faith: the handcrafted Web from 1999 to 2004
excerpt: There was something almost ceremonial about opening a browser at the turn of the millennium. Between 1999 and 2004, the Web was a raw, sometimes laborious territory where every pixel earned tasted like a small victory.

title: Habibi !
excerpt: Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Senate seat. Trump and JD Vance threw everything at him, and Michigan said no. Alhamdulillah.

title: Why do they make caricatures?
excerpt: People sometimes look at my drawings and ask, half amused and half suspicious, why I bother. The honest answer is that the façade doesn't need me. The man with the stamps does.
